label: Birth in Makkah
summary: Born into Banu Hashim; father Abdullah had passed before birth; mother Aminah; nurtured by Halimah then mother and grandfather.

label: First revelation
summary: Cave of Hira — "Iqra" — beginning of prophethood; Khadijah's support and Waraqah's affirmation.

label: Open preaching
summary: Islam proclaimed openly; trials of early Muslims; boycott and patience of the community.

label: Isra and Mi'raj
summary: Night journey and ascension; salah enjoined as a gift and anchor for the believers.

label: Hijrah to Madinah
summary: Migration marks the Islamic calendar; brotherhood between Muhajirin and Ansar; Masjid an-Nabawi established.

label: Madinah society
summary: Constitution of coexistence; strengthening of salah, zakat, and community ethics; facing hypocrisy with wisdom.

label: Badr
summary: Turning point of resolve; reliance on Allah alongside preparation; mercy and ransoming taught even in conflict.

label: Uhud
summary: Discipline and obedience under pressure; the Prophet's steadfastness and care for the wounded.

label: Khandaq (Trench)
summary: Unity and digging the trench; calm in siege; surah al-Ahzab context of protection and truth.

label: Treaty of Hudaybiyah
summary: Strategic patience; trust in Allah's plan; doors opened for wider da'wah and eventual access to Makkah.

label: Conquest of Makkah
summary: Mercy on a day of victory; cleansing the Ka'bah; forgiveness offered where bitterness could have ruled.

label: Farewell Hajj & passing
summary: Comprehensive legacy sermon; completion of the message; illness and return to Allah with community united in salah.
